athlete_note: Athlete programmes must account for training age, position/event, competition calendar, practice volume, injury history and access to qualified coaches. Do not assume bodybuilding or powerlifting templates are appropriate for team-sport athletes.

records.programme_design_implications: Position-specific demands; qualified coaching; contact and match load dominate fatigue planning

records.programme_design_implications: Manage court volume; use multidirectional work and shoulder/scapular strength

records.important_physical_qualities: Aerobic capacity, running economy, tissue tolerance, pacing

records.important_physical_qualities: Aerobic/anaerobic capacity, shoulder function, trunk control, technique

records.important_physical_qualities: Aerobic capacity, sustained power, local muscular endurance
